articles.title: Bernadette Moffat, 81, Playground Monitor
articles.deck: Friends remember Bernadette Moffat for the many years of service to Hickory Ridge.
body: Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Kettle Hill Block Association in his or her name.

Born in Hickory Ridge in the years after the war, Bernadette Moffat spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Bernadette Moffat died in June at home on Linden Road, at the age of 81.

Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Hickory Ridge. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Kettle Hill Block Association in his or her name.

articles.title: Letter: The Park Bench Program on Spring Lane Needs Attention
body: To the editor: Please keep the park bench program in the budget. Many of us on Spring Lane use it every week. To the editor: I have lived on Spring Lane for 27 years, and I want to say what a difference the Millrace Youth Center has made.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the April meeting.
Karl Fontaine, Tannery Flats
